native_library: original22H374 QuartzCore default.metallib; portable AIR slice only
compiler_language: Mesa AMD_gpu_shader_half_float syntax used only inside the private compiler; no OpenGL/AMD device capability advertised
half_arithmetic: AIR scalar/vector IEEE binary16 SSA, explicit float16_t/f16vec values and f16 operations/conversions in NIR/IR3; half texture values rounded before use; no float32 alias
stage_transport: existing float32 hardware interface; half values converted at stage boundaries; logical half varying identities include a precision suffix for type-safe linking
half_memory: typed16-bit SSBO alias views for packed scalar/vector loads/stores; exact byte GEPs and per-lane2-byte NIR bounds/alignment guards; A5xx LDGB/STGB TYPE_U16 and half registers; no widened word store
fragment_outputs: float/half scalars or vectors1..4; float32 color transport, missing channels0 and alpha1
air_intrinsics: half texture sample/read/write with typed metadata validation
dfdx/dfdy/fwidth; half derivatives transported through float32 and narrowed
function-constant any/all.v2..4i1 predicates exposed to LLVM constant propagation
function_constants: shared host/runtime State: bounded native aggregate evaluation, typed any/all boolean reductions, SCCP and ADCE before InstCombine then SimplifyCFG and ADCE; native fast-math/address-space/alias metadata preserved; active whole-poison returns still rejected
profile_proof_scope: production runtime LLVM C API frontend, in-memory IR3 compiler, JIT profile, existing kernel linker and framebuffer snapshot PipelineEncoder; original QuartzCore AIR; offline only
remaining: remaining CoreAnimation fragment profiles/helpers and language operations beyond the documented native configurations
framebuffer snapshot cost; general buffer/texture raster-order groups and imageblocks
full pipeline/function descriptor SPI and system selection
broader native CoreAnimation color formats, including wider and float render targets
half shared memory, MSL half source syntax, remaining integer/AIR operations
native GPU/display shared scanout/fences and target execution
fixed_profile_scope: untouched native AIR and normal native Metal function-constant specialization; profiles are diagnostic inputs, not hard-coded replacements or forced defaults

texture_profile_bindings.lod_bias_format: float32 scalar; choose zero for no LOD bias
texture_profile_bindings.destination_snapshot_scope: legacy five configurations use separate application-bound destination texture0; new native framebuffer configurations use private per-primitive snapshots without that binding

fixed_color_scope: input half4 color with clamped output alpha; texture-color multiplies sampled half4 by color; source-over uses source + destination * (1-source.a), then clamps output alpha
framebuffer_position_aliases: native fixed fragment arguments may alias the same center/no-perspective float4 position; both map to gl_FragCoord after exact metadata/type validation
